# A dictionary for a disconnected trip

Download a licensed dictionary database before departure and open it with a local reader. Word lookup then uses only the stored database and needs neither an account nor a network connection. The sentence being read is not submitted to a translation website.

Test inflected forms and the languages you need while still at home. A bilingual dictionary offers meanings and examples, but will not rewrite an entire paragraph idiomatically. Keep a small list of unresolved usages for later study. Disable optional online suggestions if the reader offers them.
